name: The Drafters
patron: The bench, by standing order rather than by retainer.
holds: The three who write what binds, under their own names.
because: The reasons are the part that outlives everybody and they were being produced by people the record did not mention. Making them a faction rather than staff is the whole correction: a patron pays the expense and the work carries the worker’s name.
produces_mostly: opinions, signed by the people who wrote them
study: Whether attribution changes the writing. The bench has forty years of unsigned drafts to compare against.
anchor: The attribution gap, closed by paying for the work instead of retaining the worker.
